items.lede: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.
items.title: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance

items.lede: New media empire will be known as Skydance, with CEO David Ellision calling it a 'historic day.'
items.title: Controversial $110 billion mega-merger of Paramount and Warner Bros. finally closes

items.lede: Paramount now owns Warner Bros. as last-ditch effort to stop $111B merger fails.
items.title: Paramount completes $111B Warner merger, creating “Skydance” behemoth
